notes: These daytime overlays depict sunlight partially or fully obscured by the matching condition.
Existing accepted source artwork remains unchanged; the owner accepted these nine variants on October 27, 2026.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one separate transparent RGBA sun-obscuration overlay for an existing mobile moon/weather widget. Image 1 is the accepted isolated sun and Image 2 the accepted overcast cloud style; use them as visual references, not as images to reproduce wholesale. Depict FULLY OVERCAST DAYLIGHT: a compact thick dimensional blue-gray cloud completely hides the sun's disk, with only a subtle warm-white diffused backlight and softly lit cloud rim to indicate the sun behind it. Do not show a visible sun disk or starburst. Keep the entire cloud and glow localized in the upper-right area, comparable to the sun in Image 1; leave the rest of the canvas genuinely transparent and clear for a separate centered moon. Match the cinematic, softly luminous, almost photorealistic blue-gray weather art. Designed to remain legible when this layer is composited into a 128px widget. No moon, text, scenery, sky background, checkerboard, frame, precipitation or lightning.
